ex.en: He put his things carelessly in the drawer.
ex.zh: 他隨手把東西丟進抽屜。

ex.en: All the desk drawers were empty.
ex.zh: 所有書桌抽屜都是空的。

ex.en: I found this in your desk drawer.
ex.zh: 我在你的書桌抽屜裡找到這個。

drawer.en: a box in a piece of furniture that you pull out to keep things in

ex.en: We had a fire drill yesterday.
ex.zh: 我們昨天進行了消防演習。

ex.en: This is only a drill, so please stay calm.
ex.zh: 這只是演習，請保持冷靜。

drill.en: practice of what to do in an emergency

ex.en: I need a drill to put up this shelf.
ex.zh: 我需要一支電鑽來裝這個架子。

ex.en: The noise from the drill was terrible.
ex.zh: 電鑽的聲音吵死了。

drill.en: a tool used for making holes

ex.en: They drilled a hole in the wall.
ex.zh: 他們在牆上鑽了一個洞。

ex.en: The company is drilling for oil offshore.
ex.zh: 這家公司正在海上鑽探石油。

drill.en: to make a hole using a special tool

ex.en: Last year the region was visited by the worst drought in 60 years.
ex.zh: 去年那個地區遭遇了六十年來最嚴重的乾旱。

ex.en: During droughts, farmers are barely able to eke out a living.
ex.zh: 乾旱時期，農民幾乎無法維持生計。

drought.en: a long period with very little rain

ex.en: What are the advantages and drawbacks of this method?
ex.zh: 這個方法有什麼優點和缺點？

ex.en: The only drawback is the high price.
ex.zh: 唯一的缺點是價格太高。

ex.en: Working from home has some drawbacks.
ex.zh: 在家工作有一些缺點。

drawback.en: a disadvantage that makes something less attractive

ex.en: Jim likes to play the drum.
ex.zh: 吉姆喜歡打鼓。

ex.en: She can play the drum.
ex.zh: 她會打鼓。

ex.en: Tom plays the bongo drums.
ex.zh: 湯姆會打邦哥鼓。

drum.en: a musical instrument that you hit with sticks or your hands

ex.en: The oil was stored in large metal drums.
ex.zh: 石油存放在大型金屬桶裡。

ex.en: Several drums of chemicals were found in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 倉庫裡發現好幾桶化學品。

drum.en: a large round container used for storing oil or chemicals

ex.en: She drummed her fingers on the desk.
ex.zh: 她用手指在桌上敲著。

ex.en: Rain drummed on the roof all night.
ex.zh: 雨整夜打在屋頂上。

drum.en: to hit a surface again and again with a regular beat

drum.zh: drum up：招攬、爭取（生意、支持）

ex.en: We need to drum up more business this quarter.
ex.zh: 這一季我們需要招攬更多生意。

ex.en: The team is trying to drum up support for the project.
ex.zh: 團隊正努力為這個專案爭取支持。

drum.en: to work hard to get more customers, support or interest

ex.en: Meanwhile, the circumstances have changed drastically.
ex.zh: 在這段期間，情況有了巨大的變化。

ex.en: They monopolized the supply market and drastically raised prices.
ex.zh: 他們壟斷了供應市場，並大幅調漲價格。

ex.en: Sales have dropped drastically this quarter.
ex.zh: 這一季的銷售量大幅下滑。

drastically.en: in a very big and sudden way

ex.en: I saw a white cloud drifting across the sky.
ex.zh: 我看到一朵白雲在天空中飄過。

ex.en: Fluffy white clouds drift across the sky one by one.
ex.zh: 一朵朵蓬鬆的白雲從天空飄過。

drift.en: to be carried slowly along by water or air

drift.zh: 漫無目的地過日子；（關係）漸漸疏遠

ex.en: Many people drift through life without a purpose.
ex.zh: 許多人毫無目標地隨波逐流過日子。

ex.en: Over the years, we drifted apart.
ex.zh: 這些年來，我們漸漸疏遠了。

drift.en: to move slowly into a situation or away from someone without planning it

ex.en: Do you get my drift?
ex.zh: 你懂我的意思嗎？

ex.en: I didn't catch every word, but I got the drift.
ex.zh: 我沒有每個字都聽懂，但大概知道意思。

drift.en: the general meaning of what someone says

drain.zh: 排出（液體）、把水放掉、瀝乾

ex.en: Have you drained the bathtub?
ex.zh: 你把浴缸裡的水放掉了嗎？

ex.en: Drain the pasta and add the sauce.
ex.zh: 把義大利麵瀝乾，再加入醬汁。

drain.en: to let a liquid flow out of something until it is empty

ex.en: The drains are blocked up.
ex.zh: 排水管堵住了。

ex.en: Don't pour oil down the drain.
ex.zh: 不要把油倒進排水孔。

drain.en: a pipe or hole that carries away dirty water

ex.en: The long meeting completely drained me.
ex.zh: 那場冗長的會議讓我筋疲力盡。

ex.en: The project is draining our budget.
ex.zh: 這個專案正在耗光我們的預算。

drain.en: to use up all of someone's strength or a supply of something

ex.en: He drove the car, listening to music on the radio.
ex.zh: 他一邊開車，一邊聽收音機的音樂。

ex.en: Tom drives his car to work every day.
ex.zh: 湯姆每天開車上班。

drive.en: to control a car or other vehicle and make it move

ex.en: It is an hour's drive from here to there.
ex.zh: 從這裡開車到那裡要一個小時。

ex.en: It's a short drive to the airport.
ex.zh: 開車到機場很近。

drive.en: a trip in a car, or the time it takes

ex.en: Can you drive me to the station?
ex.zh: 你可以開車載我去車站嗎？

ex.en: My dad drove me to school.
ex.zh: 我爸開車載我去學校。

drive.en: to take someone somewhere in a car

ex.en: Save the file to the shared drive.
ex.zh: 把檔案存到共用磁碟。

ex.en: My hard drive is almost full.
ex.zh: 我的硬碟快滿了。

drive.en: a part of a computer or a network where files are stored

ex.en: Strong demand is driving prices up.
ex.zh: 強勁的需求推升了價格。

ex.en: What drives you to work so hard?
ex.zh: 是什麼驅使你這麼努力工作？

drive.en: to be the main cause that makes something happen or change

ex.en: Our math teacher drew a circle on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 數學老師在黑板上畫了一個圓。

ex.en: I'm not good at drawing, but I can write.
ex.zh: 我不擅長畫畫，但我會寫作。

draw.en: to make a picture or shape with a pencil or pen

ex.en: The exhibition has drawn much attention from the public.
ex.zh: 這個展覽吸引了大眾很多注意。

ex.en: The festival draws thousands of visitors every year.
ex.zh: 這個節慶每年吸引數千名遊客。

ex.en: Let's draw lots to decide who goes first.
ex.zh: 我們抽籤決定誰先吧。

ex.en: The winners will be drawn next Friday.
ex.zh: 得獎者將於下週五抽出。

draw.en: to pick a ticket or number by chance to decide a winner

ex.en: Please draw the curtains.
ex.zh: 請把窗簾拉上。

ex.en: I need to draw some money from the bank.
ex.zh: 我需要從銀行領一些錢。

draw.en: to pull curtains across, or to take money out of a bank account

ex.en: The match ended in a draw.
ex.zh: 比賽以平手收場。

ex.en: It was a 1–1 draw.
ex.zh: 比賽一比一平手。

draw.en: a game that ends with the same score for both sides

ex.en: I dropped my phone on the floor.
ex.zh: 我把手機掉到地上了。

ex.en: Be careful not to drop the glasses.
ex.zh: 小心別把杯子摔了。

drop.en: to fall, or to let something fall by accident

ex.en: I think the wind's dropping off.
ex.zh: 我覺得風變小了。

ex.en: Prices dropped sharply last month.
ex.zh: 上個月價格大幅下跌。

ex.en: I felt a drop of rain on my head.
ex.zh: 我感覺有一滴雨落在頭上。

ex.en: A pool begins with many drops of water.
ex.zh: 一池水是由許多水滴匯聚而成的。

drop.en: a very small amount of liquid in a round shape

ex.en: If you have time, please drop in on us.
ex.zh: 你有空就來我們家坐坐吧。

ex.en: Feel free to drop by my office anytime.
ex.zh: 隨時歡迎來我辦公室坐坐。

drop.en: to visit someone for a short time without planning it

ex.en: Yanni dropped the PC off at the repair shop.
ex.zh: 雅尼把電腦送去維修店。

ex.en: Can you drop me off at the station?
ex.zh: 你可以載我到車站讓我下車嗎？

drop.en: to take someone or something to a place and leave them there

ex.en: I am not used to drinking coffee without sugar.
ex.zh: 我不習慣喝不加糖的咖啡。

ex.en: You should drink more water every day.
ex.zh: 你每天應該多喝水。

drink.en: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it

ex.en: You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
ex.zh: 你尤其不該空腹喝酒。

ex.en: My father used to drink till late at night.
ex.zh: 我父親以前常喝酒喝到深夜。

ex.en: Tom told me that he doesn't like carbonated drinks.
ex.zh: 湯姆跟我說他不喜歡碳酸飲料。

ex.en: Can I get you a drink?
ex.zh: 要不要幫你拿杯喝的？

drink.en: a liquid that people swallow, or one serving of alcohol

ex.en: When taking drugs, follow the directions on the bottle carefully.
ex.zh: 服藥時請仔細遵照瓶上的說明。

ex.en: This drug may cause side effects.
ex.zh: 這種藥可能會有副作用。

drug.en: a substance used to treat or prevent illness

ex.en: Tom has a long history of drug abuse.
ex.zh: 湯姆有長期濫用藥物的紀錄。

ex.en: Many criminals in America are addicted to drugs.
ex.zh: 美國很多罪犯都有毒癮。

drug.en: an illegal substance that people take for its effect on the mind

ex.en: She spends most of her money on her dresses.
ex.zh: 她大部分的錢都花在買洋裝上。

ex.en: She went into her room to change her dress.
ex.zh: 她回房間換洋裝。

ex.en: She bought six yards of cloth for a dress.
ex.zh: 她買了六碼布來做洋裝。

dress.en: a piece of women's clothing that covers the body and legs in one piece

ex.en: Tom is dressed a little more casually than usual.
ex.zh: 湯姆穿得比平時稍微隨便一點。

ex.en: She aided her daughter in dressing.
ex.zh: 她幫女兒穿衣服。

ex.en: You should dress formally for the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時你應該穿得正式一點。

dress.en: to put clothes on yourself or someone else

ex.en: What is the dress code for the dinner?
ex.zh: 晚宴的服裝規定是什麼？

ex.en: The office has a casual dress code.
ex.zh: 這間辦公室的服裝規定很休閒。

dress.en: the kind of clothes that people wear, especially for an occasion

ex.en: I don't have any money, but I have dreams.
ex.zh: 我沒有錢，但我有夢想。

ex.en: Working abroad has always been my dream.
ex.zh: 到國外工作一直是我的夢想。

dream.en: something you very much want to happen in the future

ex.en: I had a strange dream last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚做了一個奇怪的夢。

ex.en: Good night and sweet dreams!
ex.zh: 晚安，祝你好夢！

dream.en: pictures and events that you see in your mind while you sleep

ex.en: From childhood I dreamed of being a pastry cook.
ex.zh: 我從小就夢想成為糕點師傅。

ex.en: I never dreamed that I would win first prize.
ex.zh: 我從沒想過自己會得到頭獎。

dream.en: to think about something you want very much

ex.en: How could I be a robot? Robots don't dream.
ex.zh: 我怎麼可能是機器人呢？機器人不會做夢。

ex.en: I often dream about my old school.
ex.zh: 我常夢到以前的學校。

dream.en: to see pictures and events in your mind while you sleep

ex.en: It has been the driest June for thirty years.
ex.zh: 這是三十年來最乾的六月。

ex.en: Cold and dry, splendid sunshine, what beautiful winter weather!
ex.zh: 寒冷乾燥、陽光燦爛，多美的冬日天氣！

ex.en: My throat feels dry and raw and scratchy.
ex.zh: 我的喉嚨又乾又痛又癢。

dry.en: having no water or liquid on or in it

ex.en: This is an appliance for drying clothes.
ex.zh: 這是用來烘乾衣服的電器。

ex.en: Please dry your hands with this towel.
ex.zh: 請用這條毛巾擦乾你的手。

dry.en: to remove the water from something

ex.en: The lecture was long and dry.
ex.zh: 這場演講又長又枯燥。

ex.en: The report is accurate but a bit dry.
ex.zh: 這份報告很準確，但有點枯燥。

ex.en: Some of the drivers were laughing and yelling.
ex.zh: 有些司機又笑又叫。

ex.en: Drivers must observe the traffic rules.
ex.zh: 駕駛必須遵守交通規則。

ex.en: You're still too young to get a driver's license.
ex.zh: 你還太小，不能考駕照。

driver.en: a person who controls a car, bus or truck

ex.en: You need to update the printer driver.
ex.zh: 你需要更新印表機驅動程式。

ex.en: I downloaded the latest drivers for my graphics card.
ex.zh: 我下載了顯示卡的最新驅動程式。

driver.en: a program that lets a computer work with a device

ex.en: Innovation is a key driver of growth.
ex.zh: 創新是成長的關鍵驅動力。

ex.en: Cost was the main driver behind the decision.
ex.zh: 成本是做這個決定的主要原因。

driver.en: something that makes a change or an activity happen

ex.en: I am writing a draft of the speech.
ex.zh: 我正在寫演講的草稿。

ex.en: Please send me the first draft of the report by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前把報告初稿寄給我。

draft.en: a first version of a piece of writing that may be changed later

ex.en: My manager asked me to draft a reply to the client.
ex.zh: 我的主管請我草擬給客戶的回信。

ex.en: The lawyer is drafting the new contract.
ex.zh: 律師正在起草新合約。

draft.en: to write a first version of something

ex.en: The payment was made by bank draft.
ex.zh: 這筆款項是用銀行匯票支付的。

ex.en: Please enclose a bank draft with your application.
ex.zh: 申請時請附上銀行匯票。

draft.en: a written order for a bank to pay money to someone

ex.en: Draft beer tastes especially good on a hot day.
ex.zh: 大熱天喝生啤酒特別好喝。

ex.en: We don't sell draft beer.
ex.zh: 我們不賣生啤酒。

draft.en: served from a large container, not from a bottle or can

ex.en: There has been a dramatic increase in online sales.
ex.zh: 網路銷售大幅成長。

ex.en: The city has seen dramatic changes in recent years.
ex.zh: 這座城市近年來變化很大。

dramatic.en: sudden, very big or easy to notice

ex.en: Don't be so dramatic; it's just a small mistake.
ex.zh: 別那麼誇張，只是個小錯誤。

ex.en: The movie has a dramatic ending.
ex.zh: 這部電影的結局很戲劇性。

dramatic.en: full of strong feeling or action, or showing feelings too much

ex.en: The new TV drama is quite interesting.
ex.zh: 這部新電視劇相當有趣。

ex.en: Do you watch Korean dramas?
ex.zh: 你看韓劇嗎？

ex.en: Which drama series do you like best?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡哪一部電視劇？

drama.en: a play or a TV show that tells a serious story

ex.en: I don't want any drama at work.
ex.zh: 我不想在工作上有任何風波。

ex.en: There was a lot of drama at the meeting yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天的會議上鬧得很不愉快。

drama.en: an exciting or upsetting situation, often with arguments

ex.en: Tom dragged himself out of bed and put on his clothes.
ex.zh: 湯姆拖著身子下了床，穿上衣服。

ex.en: He dragged the heavy box across the floor.
ex.zh: 他把那個重箱子拖過地板。

drag.en: to pull something heavy along the ground with effort

ex.en: Drag the file into this folder.
ex.zh: 把檔案拖曳到這個資料夾裡。

ex.en: You can drag and drop photos here.
ex.zh: 你可以把照片拖放到這裡。

drag.en: to move something on a screen by holding down a mouse button

ex.en: The long meeting was a real drag.
ex.zh: 那場冗長的會議真是無聊透頂。

ex.en: High costs are a drag on our growth.
ex.zh: 高成本拖累了我們的成長。

drag.en: a person or thing that is boring or annoying

ex.en: Sales have increased dramatically this year.
ex.zh: 今年的銷售額大幅成長。

ex.en: Prices dropped dramatically after the holiday.
ex.zh: 假期過後價格大幅下跌。

ex.en: The city has changed dramatically in ten years.
ex.zh: 這座城市十年來變化很大。

dramatically.en: in a sudden and very big way

ex.en: She sighed dramatically and left the room.
ex.zh: 她誇張地嘆了口氣，離開了房間。

ex.en: He paused dramatically before announcing the winner.
ex.zh: 他在宣布得獎者之前刻意停頓了一下。

dramatically.en: in a way that shows feelings too strongly

ex.en: There is a dragonfly on the ceiling.
ex.zh: 天花板上有一隻蜻蜓。

ex.en: A dragonfly landed on the water.
ex.zh: 一隻蜻蜓停在水面上。

ex.en: The kids tried to catch a dragonfly in the park.
ex.zh: 孩子們在公園裡想抓一隻蜻蜓。

dragonfly.en: a large insect with a long thin body and two pairs of wings

ex.en: I like drizzles, not rainstorms.
ex.zh: 我喜歡毛毛雨，不喜歡暴雨。

ex.en: There will be light drizzle in the morning.
ex.zh: 早上會有零星毛毛雨。

drizzle.en: light rain with very small drops

ex.en: It's drizzling outside, so take an umbrella.
ex.zh: 外面在下毛毛雨，帶把傘吧。

ex.en: Drizzle some honey over the pancakes.
ex.zh: 在鬆餅上淋一點蜂蜜。

drizzle.en: to rain lightly, or to pour a thin line of liquid over food

ex.en: I think that Tom and Mary are both drunk.
ex.zh: 我想湯姆和瑪麗都喝醉了。

ex.en: Tom got drunk with his friends in the park.
ex.zh: 湯姆和他的朋友們在公園喝醉了。

ex.en: A drunk driver was responsible for the car accident.
ex.zh: 喝醉的駕駛員對車禍有責任。

drunk.en: affected by too much alcohol, so you cannot think or move well

ex.en: Children and drunks tell the truth.
ex.zh: 實話從小孩及酒鬼口中出。

ex.en: A drunk was sleeping on the bench outside the station.
ex.zh: 一個醉漢睡在車站外的長椅上。

drunk.en: a person who is often affected by too much alcohol

ex.en: Why do you think animals dread fire?
ex.zh: 你覺得動物為什麼會怕火呢？

ex.en: Cleaning up the house is truly my most dreaded task.
ex.zh: 打掃屋子真的是我最害怕的工作。

ex.en: I dread going to the dentist.
ex.zh: 我很怕去看牙醫。

dread.en: to feel very afraid or worried about something that may happen

ex.en: She lived in constant dread of losing her job.
ex.zh: 她始終活在怕丟掉工作的恐懼中。

ex.en: He waited for the exam results with dread.
ex.zh: 他懷著恐懼等待考試成績。

dread.en: a strong feeling of fear about something that may happen

ex.en: She became drowsy after supper.
ex.zh: 晚飯後她變得昏昏欲睡。

ex.en: I'd just woken up and was still drowsy.
ex.zh: 我那時剛起床，還迷迷糊糊的。

ex.en: This cold medicine may make you drowsy, so don't drive.
ex.zh: 這種感冒藥可能會讓人想睡，所以不要開車。

drowsy.en: feeling tired and ready to sleep

ex.en: The consequences of Sendai's earthquake were dreadful!
ex.zh: 仙台地震造成的後果非常可怕！

ex.en: We had a dreadful vacation because it rained every single day.
ex.zh: 我們的假期糟透了，因為每天都在下雨。

ex.en: That tall boy saved the drowning child.
ex.zh: 那個高個少年救了溺水兒童。

ex.en: I came near to being drowned.
ex.zh: 我差一點淹死。

ex.en: The child knows how to swim, so she won't drown in the water.
ex.zh: 這孩子會游泳，所以不會溺水。

drown.en: to die or kill by being under water and unable to breathe

ex.en: The loud music drowned out our conversation.
ex.zh: 大聲的音樂蓋過了我們的談話聲。

ex.en: She drowned her sorrows in work after the breakup.
ex.zh: 分手後，她把悲傷寄託在工作上。

drown.en: to be so loud that other sounds cannot be heard

ex.en: He's a drunkard.
ex.zh: 他是個酒鬼。

ex.en: Her father was a drunkard who spent all his money on beer.
ex.zh: 她父親是個酒鬼，把錢全花在啤酒上。

ex.en: The drunkard fell asleep on a bench in the park.
ex.zh: 那個酒鬼在公園的長椅上睡著了。

drunkard.en: a person who often drinks too much alcohol

ex.en: The inspection found a drainage problem behind the retaining wall.
ex.zh: 檢查發現擋土牆後方的排水系統有問題。

ex.en: Proper drainage prevents water from collecting near the foundation.
ex.zh: 完善的排水設計可避免水積在地基附近。

drainage.en: the way water is taken away from a place, or the pipes that do this

ex.zh: 我們旅行時參觀了德勒斯登的一間博物館。

ex.en: Many people felt the new rules were too draconian.
ex.zh: 許多人覺得新規定太嚴苛了。

ex.en: The school's draconian punishments scared the students.
ex.zh: 學校嚴苛的懲罰讓學生們很害怕。

ex.en: A druid was a priest in ancient Celtic society.
ex.zh: 德魯伊是古代凱爾特社會中的祭司。

ex.en: Some people gather at Stonehenge to celebrate like a druid.
ex.zh: 有些人聚集在巨石陣，像德魯伊一樣舉行慶祝。

ex.en: The draper sold cloth and curtains in the old market.
ex.zh: 這位布商在老市場販賣布料和窗簾。

ex.en: Her grandfather worked as a draper for forty years.
ex.zh: 她的祖父當了四十年的布商。

ex.en: The dragoon rode his horse along the road.
ex.zh: 那名龍騎兵騎著馬沿路前進。

ex.en: The museum has a uniform worn by a dragoon.
ex.zh: 博物館展示著一件龍騎兵穿過的制服。

ex.en: The dryness of the desert air made my lips crack.
ex.zh: 沙漠空氣的乾燥讓我的嘴唇乾裂。

ex.en: Use this cream if you are worried about dryness in winter.
ex.zh: 如果你擔心冬天皮膚乾燥，可以用這條乳霜。

dryness.zh: （言語或文字的）枯燥乏味；冷淡

ex.en: The dryness of his lecture put half the class to sleep.
ex.zh: 他演講的枯燥乏味讓半個班級都睡著了。

ex.en: She answered with a certain dryness that showed she was not pleased.
ex.zh: 她回答時帶著一絲冷淡，顯示她並不高興。

ex.en: The draftsman drew detailed plans for the new bridge.
ex.zh: 製圖員為新橋畫出詳細的設計圖。

ex.en: My uncle works as a draftsman at an engineering firm.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在一家工程公司擔任製圖員。

ex.en: The draftsman corrected the measurements on the blueprint.
ex.zh: 製圖員更正了藍圖上的尺寸。

ex.en: The drooping flowers needed water badly.
ex.zh: 那些下垂的花朵急需澆水。

ex.en: He had drooping shoulders after the long day.
ex.zh: 漫長的一天後，他的肩膀無力地垂著。

ex.en: The drafter of the contract made a few small mistakes.
ex.zh: 這份合約的起草人犯了幾個小錯誤。

ex.en: She is the main drafter of the new school policy.
ex.zh: 她是新校規的主要起草人。

ex.en: We collected driftwood on the beach for the campfire.
ex.zh: 我們在海灘上撿漂流木來生營火。

ex.en: She made a lamp from a piece of driftwood.
ex.zh: 她用一塊漂流木做了一盞燈。

ex.en: The baby is dreaming and smiling in her sleep.
ex.zh: 寶寶正在做夢，睡夢中還笑著。

ex.en: He is dreaming of opening his own cafe.
ex.zh: 他夢想著開一間自己的咖啡店。

ex.en: The village in the fog had a dreamlike beauty.
ex.zh: 霧中的村莊有種如夢似幻的美。

ex.en: The film has a strange, dreamlike atmosphere.
ex.zh: 這部電影有種奇異如夢的氛圍。

ex.en: We could hear the steady drumbeat from far away.
ex.zh: 我們從很遠的地方就能聽到穩定的鼓聲。

ex.en: The drumbeat got faster as the dancers moved.
ex.zh: 隨著舞者移動，鼓聲變得越來越快。

ex.en: Dredging the harbor lets bigger ships come in.
ex.zh: 疏浚港口讓更大的船能夠進港。

ex.en: The river needs dredging every few years.
ex.zh: 這條河每隔幾年就需要疏浚。

ex.en: She dropped her keys on the floor.
ex.zh: 她把鑰匙掉到地上。

ex.en: The temperature dropped sharply overnight.
ex.zh: 氣溫在一夜之間驟降。

dropped.zh: 放棄；中途退出（drop 的過去式）

ex.en: He dropped the class after the first week.
ex.zh: 他上了第一週就退掉那門課。

ex.en: The police dropped the case for lack of evidence.
ex.zh: 警方因證據不足而撤銷了此案。

ex.en: Washing dishes by hand every night felt like pure drudgery.
ex.zh: 每晚用手洗碗感覺根本就是苦差事。

ex.en: She escaped the drudgery of office work by starting her own business.
ex.zh: 她創業來擺脫辦公室工作的枯燥乏味。

ex.en: He lived as a drifter, moving from town to town.
ex.zh: 他過著漂泊的生活，從一個小鎮搬到另一個小鎮。

ex.en: The old drifter asked if he could sleep in the barn.
ex.zh: 那位老流浪漢問能不能睡在穀倉裡。

ex.en: The drummer dropped a drumstick in the middle of the song.
ex.zh: 鼓手在歌曲中途掉了一根鼓棒。

ex.en: He tapped the table with a drumstick to keep the beat.
ex.zh: 他用鼓棒敲著桌子打拍子。

ex.en: He ate a chicken drumstick with his fingers.
ex.zh: 他用手拿著雞棒腿吃。

ex.en: The kids all wanted a drumstick for dinner.
ex.zh: 孩子們晚餐都想吃棒棒腿。

ex.en: The air is drier in winter than in summer.
ex.zh: 冬天的空氣比夏天乾燥。

ex.en: Use a drier cloth to wipe the table.
ex.zh: 用比較乾的布擦桌子。

ex.en: I put the wet towels in the drier.
ex.zh: 我把濕毛巾放進烘乾機。

ex.en: She used a hair drier before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 她出門上班前用吹風機吹頭髮。

drugged.zh: 下藥；使服麻醉藥（drug 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The thief drugged the guard's coffee.
ex.zh: 小偷在警衛的咖啡裡下了藥。

ex.en: In the movie, the hero is drugged and wakes up in a strange room.
ex.zh: 電影裡，主角被下藥，醒來時人在陌生的房間。

ex.en: The old house is cold and draughty in winter.
ex.zh: 那棟老房子冬天又冷又漏風。

ex.en: We moved to a seat away from the draughty window.
ex.zh: 我們換到離漏風窗戶遠一點的座位。

ex.en: There were coffee dregs at the bottom of the cup.
ex.zh: 杯底有些咖啡渣。

ex.en: He drank the dregs of the wine and put the glass down.
ex.zh: 他喝完最後剩下的酒渣，放下了杯子。

ex.en: Some people unfairly treat the poor as the dregs of society.
ex.zh: 有些人不公平地把窮人當成社會的渣滓。

ex.en: The team's best players left, and only the dregs remained.
ex.zh: 球隊最好的球員都走了，只剩下最差的。

ex.en: The workers hung drywall in the new bedroom.
ex.zh: 工人在新臥室裡裝上石膏板。

ex.en: I patched the hole in the drywall with some filler.
ex.zh: 我用填補劑補好了石膏板上的洞。

ex.en: She gazed dreamily out the window at the clouds.
ex.zh: 她恍惚地望著窗外的雲。

ex.en: He smiled dreamily as he thought about the trip.
ex.zh: 他想著那趟旅行，恍惚地笑了。

ex.en: Leaves blocked the drainpipe, and water flooded the yard.
ex.zh: 落葉堵住排水管，水淹到了院子。

ex.en: A cat climbed up the drainpipe to the roof.
ex.zh: 一隻貓沿著排水管爬上屋頂。

dracula.zh: 德古拉（小說中的吸血鬼）

ex.en: Dracula is a famous vampire in a novel by Bram Stoker.
ex.zh: 德古拉是布萊姆．史托克小說中著名的吸血鬼。

ex.en: The children dressed up as Dracula for the school party.
ex.zh: 孩子們為了學校派對打扮成德古拉。

ex.en: The draughtsman drew the plans for the new bridge.
ex.zh: 製圖員繪製了新橋的設計圖。

ex.en: A skilled draughtsman can make very precise technical drawings.
ex.zh: 熟練的製圖員能畫出非常精確的技術圖。

ex.en: The mechanic checked the car's drivetrain for damage.
ex.zh: 技師檢查了這輛車的傳動系統有沒有損壞。

ex.en: An electric drivetrain has fewer moving parts.
ex.zh: 電動傳動系統的活動零件比較少。
